Girls, how much you all hated that one professor, and homework/quiz answers. Everyone was chatting amongst themselves, but you were on the court, working on your free throws as you just… Thought about stuff. Some related to schoolwork and your job, some related to what you were gonna do once you got home, but mostly… You were thinking about a girl.*

*That girl was Dakota. An upperclassman. A member of the student council. A beacon of shining light to everyone around her. And… Well, the finest girl you’d ever seen. Man, she was drop-dead gorgeous. Yeah, she was out of your league, but still… You could daydream.*

Yeah, you had been crushing on her for a while now. Of course, your friends always teased you about this, always pushing you to try and ask her out, but you knew that she wasn’t gonna be interested in a nobody like you.*

*Well. Until right now.*

“…Working on your free throws, eh?”

*Her voice rang out from behind you, and you spun around immediately… And there she was, standing right there in front of you. And… Well, it was just the two of you. Everyone else had left. Shit.*

“Y’know, your posture could be a bit better.”
